title: eludite.view.dock input
description: Dock a tool window (Window > Dock, the docking guides, or Pin on an auto-hidden window). With side, it docks as a new group on that edge. With tab_with, it becomes a tab in the group holding that tool window. With neither, a floating window returns to its last dock and an auto-hidden window is pinned back into its dock.

id.description: Tool window id. Omit to act on the active tool window.

side.description: Dock edge, as on the docking guides.

tab_with.description: Id of a docked or floating tool window whose group receives this window as a tab.
